description: Current line blame, and open the commit or merge/pull request that introduced it in your browser (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea).
capabilities.untrusted: Blamit runs git, which can execute code configured by the repository. It is disabled in untrusted workspaces.
config.enabled: Show the author of the current line.
config.remote: Git remote used to build URLs.
config.hosts:
Host type for self-hosted instances, keyed by the host of the remote URL. The value is either a type (`github`, `gitlab`, `gitea`) or `{ "type": ..., "url": "https://..." }` to also set the web URL (useful for SSH aliases).

Example: `{ "git.example.com": "gitea", "github-work": { "type": "github", "url": "https://github.com" } }`
